work_item.role: W1 public-evidence discovery and neutral admission

discovery_pass.method: Direction-blind search for new public same-model cross-client benchmark surfaces, followed by inspection of one immutable Octobench repository revision, its committed GOLD suite, generated result table, table generator, model map and supported benchmark launcher. Outcome direction was not used for source selection or admission.
discovery_pass.raw_artifact_limitation: Octobench gitignores results-* directories. W1 therefore admits the pinned committed generated BENCHMARK.md table as the public result surface and separately records that raw run JSON/logs/trajectories are not available from the pinned repository revision.

source_known_dimensions: same committed GOLD 20-case one-shot suite
same Octobench repository/result-table snapshot
same model key gpt-5.6-luna, mapped to gpt-5.6-luna for Codex and openai:gpt-5.6-luna for Octomind
shared committed system prompt by benchmark design
network sealed after setup and GitHub unavailable to the agent container
persistent cross-case memory disabled by benchmark design
Docker execution and clean-workspace requirements
project-specific held-out validation used for pass/fail
explicit_unknown_or_nonidentical_dimensi: exact Codex binary version/revision used by the published one-shot column
exact Octomind binary version/revision used by the published one-shot column
immutable provider endpoint/checkpoint identity beyond the committed model mapping
exact Docker image digest behind octobench-agent:latest
exact one-shot per-case timeout
exact one-shot rerun/repetition history
exact run-time judge-panel override for published judge averages
client-native scaffolding, planning primitives and step/turn ceilings intentionally remain non-identical
raw run JSON/logs/trajectories are not committed
Octomind has no canonical harness linkage in the current capability/Index corpus

non_admission_dispositions.reason: The long-run surface is a distinct sequential unit with explicit mixed rerun provenance for at least part of one Octomind column. W1 keeps it separate from the one-shot admission rather than collapsing different repetition and state-carryover semantics into one evidence record.
